summary: Audited basketball_shot_2d.py (766 lines) against library 2D layer (physics/collision/simulation/experiment) and ground-truth docs. One defect FIXED: fit_segments (now guard at lines 224-226) lacked the degenerate-x guard that library simulation.fit_segments_2d:428 has. For a segment with x-span ~0, np.polyfit(xs,ys,2) is ill-conditioned and returned garbage (demonstrated: a2=-1.09e11,a1=4.47e8,a0=2.30e12 + RankWarning) while the library cleanly skips it. Added `if xs[-1]-xs[0] < 1e-9: continue` (bit-exact to fit_segments_2d). Unreachable via UI sliders (angle 30-70 deg guarantees vx>0): 0/405 divergences before the fix; fix only changes the degenerate direct-call path. NOT FIXED (cross-file, out of my single-file write scope): 2D Magnus sign ambiguity (PLAN §1 highest-value). Standalone dv() (lines 124-128) and library physics.acceleration_2d:342-343 both compute Magnus = (+km*wz*vy, -km*wz*vx) = -(omega x v). For backspin (wz>0,vx>0) this gives DOWNWARD ay, contradicting physics.md §4.3 (omega x v = (-wz*vy,+wz*vx), y=+wz*vx>0 upward) and SIMULATION_2D_PHYSICS.md §3 verbal claim '后旋→升力向上'. The doc §3 is self-contradictory (writes the formula AND claims upward lift); the formula is duplicated identically in physics.py/experiment.py/basketball_shot_2d.py and the 6 demo scenes + test_core are calibrated to it, so it is NOT a drift and must be decided across all three files — REPORTED, not silently flipped. Minor guard diffs observed (not defects, no cosmetic fix per rules): vacuum_aim lacks lib's dist<=0 guard; simulate lacks lib's max_t<=0 guard; find_band uses want.upper() vs str(want).upper(). DRIFT TABLE (demo vs library vs doc): all 15 constants match — R=0.12, M=0.60, RHO=1.204, CD=0.47, CL=0.20, GRAV=9.81, EN=0.70, ET=0.85, YR=3.05, RIM_R=0.2287, BOARD_OFF=0.15, FT_DIST=4.60, PT_DIST=6.75 all == *_2D == doc; BD=0.021333173409760705 == DRAG_PARAM_2D (doc prints 0.02134 = rounded), BM=0.001089353535817568 == MAGNUS_PARAM_2D (doc prints 1.0895e-3 = rounded) — formula identical, doc value is rounding only; contact window [2.75,3.85], margin 0.012, bounce cap 4, scoring rule, miss branch order, outcome vocab (SWISH/BANK-IN/RATTLE-IN + 6 miss strings) all == library == doc. Display/animation: NO axis inversion (shooter x=0 left, hoop x=dist right = +x forward); seams use wz=spin*sin(ang); sliders/presets match SIMULATION_2D_GUIDE §2/§3; energy OK (Magnus ⊥ v, dot=0 => no work; rim reflect KE ratio 0.6388<1; board vx->-0.7vx/vy->0.85vy). BEFORE/AFTER probes (all identical except the intended degenerate case): free-throw swish (2.0,51,23,7.90,4.60) outcome SWISH flight 0.987 peak 3.796882252355 entry 40.510598827905 last(X,Y)=(4.638385801479,3.047060607206) plane_h 3.079484842848; bank-shot board reflect tin=(6.607450799628,-1.776882510633) tout=(-4.625215559740,-1.510350134038); find_band(2.0,51,23,4.60)=(7.855704697987,7.976510067114,7.916107382550,'SWISH'); 6 demo scenes + 405-shot grid bit-identical to library (simulate==simulate_2d, fit_segments==fit_segments_2d 0 diff).
